description: What lapses when, across all contracts, earliest first. Optional: contract_id, status (default open), kind, due_within_days (default 90), include_past (default true — a deadline that has already passed is the one worth seeing), limit. Every row says whether it was derived from the term or entered by hand, and carries its evidence.

due_within_days.description: Only deadlines due within this many days (default 90)

kind.description: Only deadlines of this kind, e.g. notice, renewal, review, payment, expiry

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

name: list_contract_deadlines
